description: Attestation of an IEC 61131-3 PLC program version: canonical Structured Text source CID, compiled program CID, setpoint-envelope table, engineer review and Council sign-off. Widening any envelope = new program version = new attestation. Per ADR-2606111000 §4 + §3.4.

stSourceCid.description: CID of the canonical IEC 61131-3 ST source

programCid.description: CID of the compiled/loaded program artifact; runtimeAttestation heartbeats compare against this

envelopeRecordUris.description: setpointEnvelope record URIs mirrored from constants compiled into this program

councilAttestationRef.description: Council attestation reference (bootstrap: PR URL / merge commit per CLAUDE.md operational premise 2026-06-11)
